messages:
maria: Quick sync 1: finalizing private-deploy launch lanes. I sketched three network topologies for MVP consideration: full VPC peering, deterministic-egress NAT, managed edge-proxy (outbound TLS tunnel). Need to pick a primary lane for the initial release and a minimal upgrade strategy. Call out must-haves vs nice-to-haves please.

raj: From eng pov: upgrade story matters a lot. Two viable upgrade flows:
- patch: helm upgrade + rolling restart (no data migration)
- migrate: blue-green with state migration for KV cache and connectors
We should avoid forced full reinstalls where possible.

liz: field notes: NorthCo and FinBeta both require a single stable egress IP for their firewall allowlists. Several others can accept NAT ranges. IP preservation for inbound peering is another ask. This is a hard requirement for some finance customers.

owen: security checklist: KMS integration required (bring-your-own-key pluggable), HSM optional for extra-controlled customers. Audit logs must be WORM/append-only for compliance customers; retention configurable up to 365d. Also require default deny for admin ports + approval flow for exposing them.

claire: pilot plan suggestion: pick 1 peering-capable customer and 1 NAT-only customer for parallel pilots. Confirm network inventory (CIDRs, proxy/NAT constraints) before kickoff. Also include telemetry budget estimate (flow logs to S3/GS).

sean: installer constraints: prefer helm-based install with simple operator, support k8s 1.22-1.26 for MVP. Preflight checks should validate node allocatable resources, CNI compatibility, and iptables/nft rules for NAT. Upgrade types: patch vs migrate (raj covered). For migrate we'll need an operator step to drain and transfer KV snapshots.

maria: proposed MVP lane (product): deterministic-egress NAT + optional peering for customers that want direct connectivity. MVP security: KMS only (no HSM), audit logs retained 90d default, flow logs enabled. Upgrade: patch path for minor; operator-assisted migrate for major. Gate criteria:
- canary on 2 pilot customers with differing topologies
- attach success rate (peering/NAT) > 99.5%
- rollback verified < 12m for config-only changes

liz: agree on the MVP lane. Field ask: collect egress requirements per-customer ASAP (CIDRs, allowed ports, throughput). I'll push SEs to collect.

owen: also flag network telemetry: per-tenant flow logs + connection audit trail. We need to estimate storage and egress cost impact.

raj: engineering ask: if product locks to NAT-first MVP, we'll produce a topology-to-effort matrix by Thurs. Need detailed list of supported topologies: peer, nat, proxy (reverse tunnel).

claire: testing/rollback: propose automated test harness that verifies state after patch and runs a synthetic workload to validate latency and token-cost impact. Include 95th-latency delta < 25ms and token-cost delta < 10% as acceptance.

maria: action items:
- liz: gather pilot customer network inventories (CIDRs, NAT constraints, allowed ports) (due Tue)
- raj/sean: topology effort + story points (due Thurs)
- owen: final KMS/audit retention spec and admin-port approval flow (due Wed)
- claire: draft pilot test harness & rollback verification checklist (due next Mon)
- me (maria): update runbook + gating matrix and publish draft for review.

deploy-bot: :information_source: Draft runbook saved: https://redwood.internal/docs/onprem/topology-mvp-runbook (internal)

maria: last call 1: any contractual/regulatory hard blocks before we lock this MVP lane? If none, I'll firm scope and trigger eng estimates. Thanks!
